title: Taylor Dayne Announces Residency at Harrah's Las Vegas
summary: TAYLOR DAYNE ANNOUNCES RESIDENCY AT HARRAHS LAS VEGAS ICONIC POP POWERHOUSE BRINGS HER SIGNATURE VOICE, ENERGY AND TIMELESS HITS TO THE LAS VEGAS STRIP; TICKETS ON SALE JULY 31 AT 10 A.M. PT LAS VEGAS, NV (July 28, 2026) Multi-platinum selling artist and pop icon Taylor Dayne is headed to the Las Vegas Strip with a new residency at Harrahs Las Vegas . Kicking off on Nov. 24, 2026, tickets go on sale Friday, July 31 at 10 a.m. PT . The announcement marks a new chapter for one of pops most enduring live performers, bringing her powerhouse vocals, signature sound and massive catalog of hit songs to one of the citys most iconic entertainment destinations. With a career spanning more than 75 million albums and singles sold worldwide, 18 individual Top 10 Billboard hits and two Grammy nominations, Dayne remains one of the defining vocalists of her generation.
